buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The detailed terms, eligibility, technical evaluation criteria, scope of work and contract conditions are given in the Buyer uploaded ATC document (RFP No. PR OJ-201/328/2026-SUDA (T M P F) SECTION / 519450-2). Bidders shall read it in f ull before bidding. 2. Eligibility: as per Section 1, Clause 7 of the RFP. Bidders shall upload all supporting documents listed in Clause 7.8 along with the technical bid. 3. Technical evaluation shall be on 100 marks as per Section 3, Clause 9 of the RFP. Only bidders scoring 75 marks or more shall qualify for opening of the fina ncial bid. Selection shall be by Least Cost Selection (L1) among technically qualified bidders.

4. The price quoted on GeM shall be the total fee for 600 visits, inclusive of GST. The rate per visit (inclusive of GST) shall not exceed Rs 47,200; bids above this ceiling shall be rejected. 5. Bidders shall upload the filled Form Fin-1 only under “Financial Document Indicating Price Break-up”, and not in the technical bid. Any price disclosed in the technical bid shall lead to rejection. In case of mi smatch, the price quoted on the GeM portal shall prevail. 6. The number of visits (600) is indicative. Payment shall be made per visit actu ally conducted and report accepted, at the quoted rate per visit, as per Section 5 of the RFP. 7. Only the original EMD instrument (where applicable) shall be sent by Register ed/Speed Post to CEO, SUDA, Block-D, 4th Floor, Indravati Bhavan, Nava Raipur Atal Nagar – 492002, to reach within 5 days of bid end date. All other document s shall be submitted online on GeM only. 8. SUDA may call for and verify the originals of any document from the L1 bidde r before award. If any document is found false or misleading, the bid shall be rej ected, the EMD forfeited, and action taken as per law. 9. The successful bidder shall submit ePBG of 5% of contract value, valid for the contract period plus 6 months, and sign the agreement (Annexure F) within 15 d ays of the GeM contract. 10. Conflict of interest, as defined in Section 1, Clause 7.6 of the RFP, shall lead to disqualification. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file.
